INSERT INTO COLLECTION ( COLLECTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IS_PUBLIC, CREATED_DT ) VALUES ( #{collectionId}, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{description,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, NVL(#{isPublic,jdbcType=CHAR}, 'Y'), SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT C.COLLECTION_ID, C.MEMBER_ID, C.TITLE, C.DESCRIPTION, C.IS_PUBLIC, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT, TO_CHAR(C.UPDATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_DT, M.NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMG_URL, NVL(CI.ITEM_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_COUNT, NVL(CL.LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS LIKE_COUNT, NVL(UC.COMMENT_COUNT, 0) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM COLLECTION C INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = C.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_ITEM GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CI ON CI.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_LIKE GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CL ON CL.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM USER_COMMENT WHERE COLLECTION_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) UC ON UC.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID WHERE C.COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE COLLECTION SET TITLE = #{title}, DESCRIPTION = #{description,jdbcType=NVARCHAR}, IS_PUBLIC = #{isPublic}, UPDATED_DT = SYSDATE WHERE COLLECTION_ID = #{collectionId}
mapper.select:
SELECT COLLECTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IS_PUBLIC, CREATED_DT, UPDATED_DT, NICKNAME, PROFILE_IMG_URL, ITEM_COUNT, LIKE_COUNT, COMMENT_COUNT FROM ( SELECT C.COLLECTION_ID, C.MEMBER_ID, C.TITLE, C.DESCRIPTION, C.IS_PUBLIC, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT, TO_CHAR(NVL(C.UPDATED_DT, C.CREATED_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_DT, M.NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMG_URL, NVL(CI.ITEM_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_COUNT, NVL(CL.LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS LIKE_COUNT, NVL(UC.COMMENT_COUNT, 0) AS COMMENT_COUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY NVL(C.UPDATED_DT, C.CREATED_DT) DESC, C.COLLECTION_ID DESC ) AS RNUM FROM COLLECTION C INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = C.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_ITEM GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CI ON CI.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_LIKE GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CL ON CL.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM USER_COMMENT WHERE COLLECTION_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) UC ON UC.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID
)
WHERE RNUM BETWEEN ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize} + 1) AND (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize})
ORDER BY RNUM

SELECT COLLECTION_ID, MEMBER_ID, TITLE, DESCRIPTION, IS_PUBLIC, CREATED_DT, UPDATED_DT, NICKNAME, PROFILE_IMG_URL, ITEM_COUNT, LIKE_COUNT, LIKED_BY_CURRENT_MEMBER, COMMENT_COUNT, PREVIEW_POSTER_URL1, PREVIEW_POSTER_URL2, PREVIEW_POSTER_URL3, PREVIEW_POSTER_URL4, PREVIEW_POSTER_URL5 FROM ( SELECT C.COLLECTION_ID, C.MEMBER_ID, C.TITLE, C.DESCRIPTION, C.IS_PUBLIC, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS CREATED_DT, TO_CHAR(NVL(C.UPDATED_DT, C.CREATED_DT), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS UPDATED_DT, M.NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMG_URL, NVL(CI.ITEM_COUNT, 0) AS ITEM_COUNT, NVL(CL.LIKE_COUNT, 0) AS LIKE_COUNT,
CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM COLLECTION_LIKE MY_CL WHERE MY_CL.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID AND MY_CL.MEMBER_ID = #{currentMemberId,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
0 AS LIKED_BY_CURRENT_MEMBER, NVL(UC.COMMENT_COUNT, 0) AS COMMENT_COUNT, CP.PREVIEW_POSTER_URL1, CP.PREVIEW_POSTER_URL2, CP.PREVIEW_POSTER_URL3, CP.PREVIEW_POSTER_URL4, CP.PREVIEW_POSTER_URL5, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY NVL(C.UPDATED_DT, C.CREATED_DT) DESC, C.COLLECTION_ID DESC ) AS RNUM FROM COLLECTION C INNER JOIN MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = C.MEMBER_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS ITEM_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_ITEM GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CI ON CI.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS LIKE_COUNT FROM COLLECTION_LIKE GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CL ON CL.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, COUNT(*) AS COMMENT_COUNT FROM USER_COMMENT WHERE COLLECTION_ID IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) UC ON UC.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COLLECTION_ID, MAX(CASE WHEN POSTER_ORDER = 1 THEN POSTER_URL END) AS PREVIEW_POSTER_URL1, MAX(CASE WHEN POSTER_ORDER = 2 THEN POSTER_URL END) AS PREVIEW_POSTER_URL2, MAX(CASE WHEN POSTER_ORDER = 3 THEN POSTER_URL END) AS PREVIEW_POSTER_URL3, MAX(CASE WHEN POSTER_ORDER = 4 THEN POSTER_URL END) AS PREVIEW_POSTER_URL4, MAX(CASE WHEN POSTER_ORDER = 5 THEN POSTER_URL END) AS PREVIEW_POSTER_URL5 FROM ( SELECT CI.COLLECTION_ID, C.POSTER_URL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY CI.COLLECTION_ID ORDER BY CI.ADDED_DT DESC, CI.CONTENT_ID DESC ) AS POSTER_ORDER FROM COLLECTION_ITEM CI INNER JOIN CONTENT C ON C.CONTENT_ID = CI.CONTENT_ID WHERE C.POSTER_URL IS NOT NULL ) WHERE POSTER_ORDER <= 5 GROUP BY COLLECTION_ID ) CP ON CP.COLLECTION_ID = C.COLLECTION_ID
)
WHERE RNUM BETWEEN ((#{pageNo} - 1) * #{pageSize} + 1) AND (#{pageNo} * #{pageSize})
ORDER BY RNUM
